settings.heading: Everything You Need to Know About Waxing

settings.text:

  • Long-Lasting Results: Hair typically regrows thinner and softer over time.

settings.heading: What You Need To Know Before Your Waxing Treatment

settings.text:
Waxing works by adhering to the hair and pulling it out from the root. Since hair grows in cycles, regular sessions ensure all follicles are targeted for smoother skin:

Pre-Treatment:

  • Let hair grow to at least a quarter of an inch.
  • Gently exfoliate 24–48 hours before your appointment.
  • Avoid heavy lotions, oils, or tanning before your session.

During Treatment:

  • Our Hot Waxing and Depileve Waxing methods aim to minimise discomfort.
  • Professional techniques and proper aftercare tips help avoid irritation.

Post-Treatment:

  • Temporary redness or sensitivity is normal and fades quickly.
  • Wear loose clothing and follow aftercare instructions.

Long-Term Benefits of Waxing:

Enjoy smooth skin for longer periods between waxing sessions. With regular waxing, you may also notice that hair regrowth becomes softer and sparser over time.

settings.heading: Does waxing hurt?
settings.content: Everyone’s pain tolerance varies. However, with quality wax products, proper techniques, and an experienced therapist, discomfort is minimised.

settings.heading: How do I prepare for a wax?
settings.content: Allow your hair to grow to about a quarter of an inch. Exfoliate gently and avoid applying lotions or oils beforehand.

settings.heading: Will my hair grow back thicker?
settings.content: No. Most people notice hair grows back finer with consistent waxing over time.

settings.heading: How often should I wax?
settings.content: Generally, you should do this every 4–6 weeks, depending on your hair growth cycle and personal preference.

settings.heading: How do I choose between a Hollywood, Brazilian, or basic bikini?
settings.content: It’s a matter of personal preference. Our therapists can guide you to the best option based on your comfort level and style.
